subject: Catalyst + Redwood: Integration Bootcamp & Roadshow Plan
messages:
From: Aaron Lee <aaron.lee@catalyst.ai>
To: Jasmine Liu <jasmine.liu@redwood.com>, Diego Fernandez <diego.fernandez@redwood.com>
Cc: partners@catalyst.ai
Date: 2026-07-20T15:03:00Z
Subject: Catalyst + Redwood: Integration Bootcamp Roadshow

Hi Jasmine / Diego —

Nice to meet you both over email. Catalyst runs a series of hands-on "Integration Bootcamp" roadshows (SF, NY, London Q4) aimed at ISVs and platform teams. We think a joint Redwood + Catalyst track would be high-signal for both of our sales motions — 45m webinar + 90m lab where attendees run an end-to-end integration and deploy a simple inference pipeline.

High-level ask: would Redwood be interested in co-hosting a track and contributing a short demo + guest blog swap? We can handle the audience marketing and venue ops, and we typically split speaker slots 50/50.

Tentative dates: Oct 12 (SF), Oct 26 (NY) — open to alternative windows.

I've attached a short partner deck with audience numbers and sponsorship options. If this is interesting I can follow up with a draft mutual action plan and a DocuSign for the sponsorship commitment.

Cheers,
Aaron
Aaron Lee | Head of Strategic Partnerships | Catalyst AI
T: +1 415 555 0132
Attachments: Catalyst_Deck_v3.pdf (PDF, 2.3MB)
From: Jasmine Liu <jasmine.liu@redwood.com>
To: Aaron Lee <aaron.lee@catalyst.ai>
Cc: Diego Fernandez <diego.fernandez@redwood.com>, Markus Klein <markus_klein@redwood.com>, Priyom Das <priyom_das@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-07-21T09:12:00Z
Subject: Re: Catalyst + Redwood: Integration Bootcamp Roadshow

Aaron —

Thanks — really excited about this. Quick answers up front: yes, we want to participate; SF and NY both look good for visibility. A few items we need to lock down before we sign:

- Sponsorship/booth cost and deliverables (slides, short video, registration list access)
- Speaker time and A/V requirements for the lab
- Lead-sharing rules and PII handling (we'll share MQLs post-event, not raw PII)
- SLA for demo environment and on-site infra support

Proposed split of responsibilities:
- Catalyst: attendee marketing, venue ops, DocuSign + sponsorship billing
- Redwood: demo content, one senior engineer on-site per city, a pre-built cloud sandbox image for attendees

Diego — can you estimate engineering time (sandbox build + runbook) and whether we can recycle the demo kit from the Summit track? Markus / Priyom — please review for pricing and legal redlines.

If you can send the DocuSign and MAP draft I’ll route to our partnerships contract queue and aim to lock dates in by Aug 6.

Best,
Jasmine Liu
Head of Partner Programs | Redwood Inference
jasmine.liu@redwood.com | +1 650 555 2190
From: Jasmine Liu <jasmine.liu@redwood.com>
To: Diego Fernandez <diego.fernandez@redwood.com>, Markus Klein <markus_klein@redwood.com>, Priyom Das <priyom_das@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-07-22T10:05:00Z
Subject: Internal: Catalyst bootcamp — operational plan and owners

Team —

Looping you in with the ask from Catalyst. Short checklist I want us to be ready with if we commit:

1) Demo kit (owner: Diego)
   - Pre-baked Docker image and Terraform scripts for a one-click sandbox (approx 6GB image).
   - Runbook for attendees + FAQ doc.

2) Speaker & content (owner: Markus)
   - 20m keynote demo + 60m hands-on lab split into two modules.
   - Blog post / guest swap to run the week after each event.

3) Commercials & legal (owner: Priyom)
   - Review sponsorship terms, lead-sharing clause, and IP language. Aim for a clean DocuSign within 10 business days.

4) Field enablement / CS on-call (owner: Diego / Partnerships ops)

Can each owner reply with a one-line ETA? I’ll consolidate and reply back to Aaron with the MAP draft.

Thanks — jasmine
From: Aaron Lee <aaron.lee@catalyst.ai>
To: Jasmine Liu <jasmine.liu@redwood.com>
Cc: Dana Morris <dana@catalyst.ai>, partners@catalyst.ai
Date: 2026-07-23T16:44:00Z
Subject: Re: Catalyst + Redwood: Integration Bootcamp Roadshow

Jasmine —

Great, thanks for the swift reply. Quick answers:
- DocuSign is live here: https://docusign.com/tx/XYZ-7890-CA — sponsorship level B (includes booth, two speakers, 25 pre-event leads).
- We can honor the PII constraint: will provide anonymized MQL export by default and raw leads only behind an approved process.
- Speakers confirmed: Aaron Lee (partnerships), Dana Morris (product), + one customer speaker TBD.

We’ll send a draft MAP by tomorrow morning. For A/V we have standard HDMI + laptop + dedicated Wi-Fi; we’ll allocate a breakout room for the lab.

If you want to push legal redlines sooner I can loop our contracts team (dana@catalyst.ai).

Looking forward to making this a repeatable joint program.

— Aaron
From: Jasmine Liu <jasmine.liu@redwood.com>
To: Aaron Lee <aaron.lee@catalyst.ai>
Cc: Diego Fernandez <diego.fernandez@redwood.com>, Markus Klein <markus_klein@redwood.com>, Priyom Das <priyom_das@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-07-24T08:30:00Z
Subject: Re: Catalyst + Redwood: Integration Bootcamp Roadshow — confirmed next steps

Aaron / Dana —

Thanks — we reviewed the DocuSign and the high-level MAP looks good. Next steps from our side:

- Diego: deliver the sandbox image and runbook by Aug 13.
- Markus: draft session slides + blog outline by Aug 6.
- Priyom: review DocuSign and send any redlines by Aug 4.

I'll attach the MAP draft we will use as a working document and track any changes there. Please confirm the SF venue name (you referenced "Pier 48" in the deck?) and the final speaker list when available.

Attaching: Redwood_MAP_v1.xlsx (mutual action plan, editable).

Best,
Jasmine Liu
Head of Partner Programs | Redwood Inference
